qualifier: splice-isoform ligand binding, activating mutants and FGFR3 cascades
name: FGFR isoform ligand binding, activating mutants and FGFR3 signaling
rationale: All members concern FGFR activation, and the theme is set apart from neighbours carrying FGFR1/FGFR2 downstream cascades by its isoform-specific (IIIb/IIIc) ligand binding, FGFR2 splicing, oncogenic point mutants and FGFR3 FRS/SHC signaling.

name: Mitochondrial depolarization in apoptosis and nucleotide biosynthesis control
rationale: Members combine mitochondrial depolarization and outer membrane permeabilization in viral and osmotic-stress apoptosis with regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis, distinguishing it from neighbours focused on nucleotide interconversion and ADP/ATP transport.

qualifier: metallothionein and MTF1, multiple non-cadmium metals
name: Metallothionein and MTF1 response to multiple metal ions
rationale: All members are responses to zinc, copper, lead, mercury, cobalt, manganese, iron or selenium centred on MTF1 and metallothioneins, unlike neighbours built on cadmium detoxification or oxidative-stress/HMOX1 responses.

name: Circadian clock coupling to nuclear-receptor metabolic regulation
rationale: Members span the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER core clock and its links to ROR/REV-ERB, PPARA, PGC-1alpha and NR1H-controlled gluconeogenesis and energy metabolism, which the lipogenic, adipogenic and glucocorticoid neighbours lack.

name: Retinoic acid biosynthesis and CYP26-mediated degradation
rationale: Members cover retinoic acid synthesis, response and CYP26B1/C1 degradation defects, separating the theme from retinol/retinal metabolism and vitamin D neighbours.

name: AKT-mediated regulation of FOXO transcription factors
rationale: All members concern control of FOXO activity, localization and target transcription by AKT phosphorylation and acetylation, absent from the NRF2, glucagon, p53 and PPAR neighbours.

name: PAPS synthesis and selenium assimilation into selenocysteine
rationale: Members link PAPS synthesis/transport (PAPSS) with selenate reduction, selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough, which the nucleotide-sugar and thyroid/anion-transport neighbours lack.

qualifier: dopamine receptor and neuropeptide signaling; drug, sleep and social behaviors
name: Dopamine and neuropeptide receptor signaling in behavior and sleep
rationale: Members are dopamine-receptor, neuropeptide and cAMP-coupled GPCR signaling and the behaviors they govern (drug responses, sleep/wake, mating, aggression), unlike neighbours centred on feeding/HPA hormones, catecholamine synthesis/transport or nicotinic receptors.

core: Receptor and non-receptor tyrosine kinase signaling
name: MET/RON and PTK6 tyrosine kinase signaling
rationale: Members cover HGF receptor MET (activation, effectors, recycling, InlB entry), MSP/RON and PTK6 signaling, distinguishing the theme from ERBB, ALK and EGFR-downregulation neighbours.

qualifier: transcriptional programme and terminal membrane maturation
name: Erythroid differentiation: transcriptional control and terminal red cell maturation
rationale: Members describe erythroid commitment and its transcriptional regulation through late membrane/cytoskeletal maturation of red cells, whereas neighbours emphasise heme synthesis, primitive/definitive erythropoiesis or megakaryocytes.

name: Targeting of membrane cargo and receptors to cilia
rationale: Members concern delivery of membrane proteins and receptors into cilia (VxPx, myristoylated, BBSome, ARL13B-INPP5E), distinct from the intraflagellar transport, basal body and photoreceptor neighbours.

name: ATP-sensitive potassium channels and SUR subunit disorders
rationale: All members are KATP channels and diseases of their ABCC8/ABCC9 sulfonylurea-receptor subunits, unlike neighbours on insulin secretion, other potassium channel families or ischemia.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and centromeric chromatin assembly
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment and resolution, mitotic/meiotic condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition, setting the theme apart from spindle/cytokinesis, meiotic recombination, nuclear envelope and histone acetylation neighbours.

qualifier: deubiquitinases, neddylation cycle and proteasome assembly
name: Deubiquitination, neddylation and proteasome assembly
rationale: Members combine DUB families and chain-specific deubiquitination with neddylation/COP9 deneddylation and proteasome assembly, which the neighbours (NF-kB regulation, ubiquitin chain synthesis) lack.

name: BDNF-TrkB and RAC1-driven postsynaptic structural plasticity
rationale: Members tie BDNF/NTRK2 and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling to postsynaptic actin remodeling, local translation and long-term structural plasticity, distinct from dendrite arborization and receptor-trafficking neighbours.

name: Striated muscle adaptation: hypertrophy, fiber-type switching and apoptosis
rationale: Members concern adaptive remodeling of striated muscle (stress hypertrophy, fast/slow fiber transition, cardiac adaptation, myocyte apoptosis), unlike neighbours on cardiac contraction/growth or atrophy.

name: Epithelial adherens junctions and apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members cover adherens junction assembly/maintenance, calcium-dependent cadherin adhesion and apical-basal polarity with apical constriction, distinguishing it from desmosome, CDH1 turnover and EMT neighbours.

core: Negative regulation of T cell activation
name: Negative regulation of T cell proliferation and IL-2/IFN-gamma production
rationale: All members restrain T cell activation, proliferation and Th1-type cytokines (IL-2, IFN-gamma), unlike neighbours on tolerance/Treg induction or other cytokines such as IL-10, IL-6.

qualifier: convergent extension in gastrulation and neurulation
name: Planar cell polarity-driven convergent extension in gastrulation and neurulation
rationale: Members are PCP/non-canonical Wnt signaling and the convergent extension, neural plate and paraxial mesoderm morphogenesis it drives, distinct from axial midline, left-right and neural plate patterning neighbours.

core: Nuclear receptor control of oxidative metabolism
name: PGC-1alpha-PPARA oxidative metabolism and ROR/REV-ERB clock regulation
rationale: Members link fatty-acid-responsive PPARA/PGC-1alpha mitochondrial biogenesis with ROR/REV-ERB regulation of BMAL/CLOCK expression, which the ChREBP, LXR/SREBP and adipogenesis neighbours lack.

name: Adenylate cyclase-cAMP activation of PKA and CREB
rationale: Members describe adenylate cyclase/forskolin-driven cAMP production activating PKA and CREB, separating it from CaMK-CREB and cAMP synthesis/degradation (PDE) neighbours.

name: Visual retinoid cycle and its inherited retinal defects
rationale: Members are the rod/cone retinoid cycle, A2E formation, light damage and LRAT/RDH/ABCA4/STRA6 deficiencies, unlike phototransduction/opsin and generic retinol-metabolism neighbours.

qualifier: with PD-L1-linked anti-tumor T cell immunity
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and PD-L1-linked tumor immunity
rationale: Members combine liver development/regeneration and suppression of death-receptor/TNF apoptosis with PD-L1 degradation and T cell responses to tumor cells, which the pro-apoptotic and PD-L1-transcription neighbours lack.

qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerves
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerve morphogenesis
rationale: Members cover morphogenesis of eye structures, cochlea/semicircular canals and the optic, trigeminal and vestibulocochlear nerves, combining features that the inner-ear fate, retinal layering and olfactory/facial nerve neighbours each have only partly.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water, urea and glycerol transport
rationale: Members center on vasopressin signaling and aquaporin-mediated water, urea and glycerol transport in kidney water balance, distinct from neighbours on sodium/chloride transport, osmotic stress and renin-angiotensin control.
